data.one_liner: MySQL and MariaDB database driver for Dart and Flutter
data.what_it_does: A library for connecting to and querying MySQL and MariaDB databases. It allows executing queries with parameters, handling results, inserting, updating data, and running multi-statement queries.
use_when: You need to connect a Dart or Flutter application directly to a MySQL or MariaDB database
You want client-side parameter binding and SQL execution similar to package:postgres
avoid_when: You are building for Flutter Web, as sockets are not supported on the web platform
You prefer an ORM or a declarative database builder like drift
strengths: Keeps behavior and defaults close to major MySQL drivers and package:postgres
Supports connection settings, parameterized queries, and batch multi-queries
weaknesses: Does not work on Flutter Web due to socket limitations
DECIMAL values are read as Strings, requiring manual parsing or third-party types for math

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick sqflite if you need local SQLite database storage on mobile instead of a remote MySQL server.

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick drift for a reactive, type-safe SQLite ORM experience.
